purpose: Map a Finnhub quote dataset (as consumed by OpenStock) into the QuantOS TP05 Data Contract with lineage and quality mapping, plus the unauthorized variant that must fail the snapshot gate.

upstream.surface: OpenStock stock detail pages -> finnhub.io/api/v1 quote/profile endpoints

findings.detail: finnhub free tier quotes are delayed (~15 minutes) per provider rules

quality_mapping.note: delayed free-tier data maps to degraded quality: usable for research, rejected for strategy/trading freshness gates

snapshot_gate.ruleset: F05 SnapshotQualityRule defaults (research: allow_degraded, no freshness; strategy/trading: strict + freshness + license)

decisions.reason: degraded quality allowed for research; license label present
degraded quality and stale data rejected by strategy gate
degraded quality and stale data rejected by trading gate; trading_approved=false

unauthorized_variant.description: same records with the license label stripped, simulating unauthorized redistribution

gate_decisions.reason: require_license: no license label on source
require_license: no license label on source
require_license: no license label on source
